name: Actions the assistant takes
summary: What the assistant can do, not just read: generate report files, set up and change emailed report schedules in web chat, and, on the unreleased mobile and field branches, create issues and tasks, comment, change asset stages and drive the app screen, with a confirmation step. Also the voice and field reporting asked for in the Field OS PRD.

roles.note: The assistant acts with the user's own token, so the Track3D service behind each action decides whether the user's role allows it. Field writes exist only on unreleased branches and are off unless the host enables them.

requirements.title: (Current behaviour) Web chat can create, change, stop and restore emailed report schedules
requirements.statement: In web chat the progress assistant can generate a PDF or CSV progress report, and create, update, delete and restore scheduled report emails, using the user's own token. It asks for missing details (frequency, recipient emails) before creating. Only deletion has a confirmation step, and that is an instruction to the model rather than a server check. Deleting is a soft delete that can be restored. Recipients can be any email addresses the user gives.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user asks "email the weekly progress report for Tower A to pm@example.com"
acceptance_criteria.when: The frequency and recipient are known
acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) The assistant creates the schedule without a separate confirmation step

acceptance_criteria.given: A user asks to stop a named schedule
acceptance_criteria.then: It names the schedule and asks for confirmation before deleting, and says it can be restored

requirements.title: Field assistant writes need a confirmation in a later turn
requirements.statement: On the mobile field branch (not released), the assistant can create an issue or task, comment on a note, and move progress assets to a new stage. These tools exist only when the host switches project writes on. The first call only returns a preview and stores the pending action; the change happens only when the user confirms and the same action, with identical details, is called again in a later turn within 15 minutes.

requirements.title: App actions only change what is on the user's screen
requirements.statement: On the mobile field branch (not released), the assistant can run the actions the current app screen offers, such as filtering a list, opening a project or structure, or switching viewer mode or date. App actions never change Track3D data; data changes use the confirmed write tools.

requirements.title: Spoken site notes become structured reports
requirements.statement: Field users should be able to speak instead of type. Voice input is turned into structured site reports and daily field reports, and the assistant asks for clarification when the recording is unclear. On the unreleased mobile branch, spoken questions are transcribed by OpenAI before the assistant answers them.
